newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh Truck closes Pierce acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh Truck closes Pierce acquisition.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said Wednesday it completed the purchase of fire truck manufacturer Pierce Manufacturing Inc for a total price of $158 million.
The acquisition is expected to have a neutral effect on earnings the first year, excluding one-time transition costs, but is expected to be highly beneficial thereafter, the company said.

Oshkosh said Pierce and Oshkosh share many suppliers which will lead to sizeable cost savings. A total annual savings of about $6.5 million is expected within two years. Operating expenses of $1 million to $2 million will be incurred the first half of fiscal 1997, the company said.
